value.description: Raises a major severity alarm when packet drop rate exceeds the defined threshold of 283 packets per second
value.name: Alarm Consequence

perfAlarmSpecThresholdCrossingDescriptio.value: Packet drop rate threshold violation detected - dropped packets per second exceeded acceptable limit

value.perfAlarmSpecAdditionalText: The packet drop rate has exceeded the defined performance threshold, indicating potential congestion or network instability. This condition may lead to degraded application performance or increased latency if not resolved promptly.
